captions.detailed: A classic city bicycle front fork assembly featuring a steel-colored unicrown fork, a black head tube sleeve, and a silver quill stem. The swept-back cruiser-style handlebars are finished with black cylindrical hand grips. The steering column is connected via a revolute joint, allowing the handlebars and fork to rotate together relative to the head tube.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a classic city bicycle front fork and handlebar assembly. The model should include a unicrown fork, a head tube sleeve, a quill stem, and swept-back cruiser handlebars with black grips, featuring a revolute joint for steering rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the fork assembly by modeling the fork legs and crown using swept profiles or lofted cylinders. Build the central head tube and steerer column using concentric cylinders. Create the quill stem with a horizontal extension, and loft or sweep a circular profile along a curved path to form the swept-back handlebars. Add cylindrical grips at the ends of the bars, assign distinct materials (steel grey and matte black), and define a revolute joint along the steering axis.
